messages:
alex: quick thought 

thinking about a minimal header-driven hinting protocol so REST clients can signal routing + quota intent without heavy client codegen. keeps runtime routing cheap and lets proto-first teams still own canonical mappings.
maria: sketch it out? i'm worried about spoofing and accidental overclaiming of quotas.
alex: rough sketch below. header names: `X-RW-Route`, `X-RW-Quota-Key`, `X-RW-Canary`, `X-RW-Trace` (opt), `X-RW-Debug-Token` (opt).
Example:
```
POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: inference.redwood.internal
Authorization: Bearer <token>
X-RW-Route: model.generate
X-RW-Quota-Key: org:acme-payments
X-RW-Canary: canary-7
{ "prompt": "Summarize..." }
```
jordan: overall i like it. policy: control-plane keeps a route registry mapping proto_service.method <-> route id. edge will accept explicit header route id or fall back to path->route lookup. keeps proto teams happy.
sam: quota semantics: priority = explicit header quota-key > tenant from token > default route bucket. need to support overridden aggregation (e.g., org vs team) and ensure telemetry surfaces both. console should show per-route and per-quota stacks.
lucy: telemetry: add `X-RW-Trace` propagation and an `X-RW-Debug-Token` that console can mint (short-lived, signed). router emits `route_hint.accept` and `route_hint.reject` counters. also track `route_fallback_count` when header absent or invalid.
maria: signed/opaque hints only. edge must validate via introspection or HMAC verification. we can't accept raw header values from public clients.
alex: agreed. plan: edge verifies header signature using tenant key (KMS). fallback: if no header or invalid sig, do lookup by path and token claims.
jordan: suggest adding a lint rule in control plane: any route id referenced by headers must exist in registry and have a canonical proto mapping; fail canary deployment if mismatched.
sam: console UX idea: route detail page with columns: calls/min, p50/p95 latency, quota used (daily/monthly), effective tenant binds, last canary id. add quick button to mint a debug token for sampling requests.
lucy: metrics to add: `rw.router.route_hint.accepted`, `rw.router.route_hint.rejected`, `rw.router.route_hint.signature_fail`, `rw.router.route_fallbacks`, `rw.router.quota.binds`, `rw.route.latency.p95_by_route`. dashboards: per-tenant, per-route, and per-quota-key views.
maria: compatibility mode for legacy clients: allow a JSON envelope fallback `{ "_route": "model.generate", "payload": { ... } }` but treat it as low-trust and not allowed to escalate quotas.
alex: perf concerns: signature verification cost. optimize with per-tenant verification key cache + short TTL and batch verify path when possible. measure in staging.
deploy-bot: router-proxy v2 deployed to staging (canary-7) - route-hints flag enabled. logs show `route_hint.accepted` spikes.
ajordan: let's ensure telemetry includes sample traces for accepted hints so we can correlate correctness.
sam: i'll write quota-resolution pseudocode and tests for multi-tenant edge cases. lucy will draft dashboard panels. alex will write RDF (short RFC) for header spec + security model + fallback rules. jordan will spec the control-plane linter.
alex: timeline: RFC posted by EOW, staging perf sweep tomorrow. :thumbsup:
